题一.

$$P = m v_{0} \Rightarrow v_{0} = \frac{P}{m}$$

$$P d = J \omega_{0} \left( J = \frac{2}{5} m R^{2} \right) \Rightarrow \omega_{0} = \frac{5 P d}{2 m R^{2}}$$

$$v_{A0}=v_{0}-R\omega_{0}=\frac{P}{m}-\frac{5Pd}{2mR^{2}}=0$$

$$d = \frac{2}{5}R$$

设 $t=t_1$ 时无滑动，则

$$v_{A}(t_{1}) = -\frac{P}{4m} + \frac{7\mu g}{2}t_{1} = 0$$

$$t_{1}=\frac{P}{14\mu mg}$$

$$v_{1}=v(t_{1})=\frac{15P}{14m}$$

$$\omega_{1}=\omega(t_{1})=\frac{15P}{14mR}$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-3.png)

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-4.png)

对P点角动量守恒:

$$J \omega_{0} + m v_{0} R = J \omega_{1} + m v_{1} R \quad ( J = \frac{2}{5} m R^{2} )$$

$$\begin{aligned}\left\{ v_{1} = R \omega_{1} \right.\end{aligned}$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-5.png)

$$P = m v_{0} , P \frac{R}{2} = J \omega_{0}$$

$$v_{1}=\frac{15P}{14m},\quad \omega_{1}=\frac{15P}{14mR}$$

$$a = \frac{f}{m} = \mu g$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-6.png)

$$v_{1}=v_{0}+at_{1}\Rightarrow t_{1}=\frac{v_{1}-v_{0}}{a}=\frac{P}{14\mu mg}$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{u}}{\mathrm{d}t} = - \frac{7}{2} \mu g \vec{e}_{u_1} \Rightarrow \vec{u} = \vec{u}_1 - \frac{7}{2} \mu g t \vec{e}_{u_1} = \vec{u}_1 \left( 1 - \frac{7}{2} \frac{\mu g}{u_1} t \right)$$

$$\vec{f} = - \mu mg \vec{e}_{u_1} = m \frac{\mathrm{d} \vec{v}}{\mathrm{d} t}$$

$$\vec{v} = \vec{v}_1 - \mu g t \vec{e}_{u_1} = \vec{v}_1 - \frac{\mu g t}{u_1} \vec{u}_1$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-7.png)

$$\vec{v}_1 = \frac{15P}{14m} \vec{i} + \frac{P}{m} \vec{j} , \vec{u}_1 = v_{1y} \vec{j} = \frac{P}{m} \vec{j} .$$

$$\vec{v} = \frac{15P}{14m} \vec{i} + \left( \frac{P}{m} - \mu g t \right) \vec{j} , \quad \vec{r} = \int_0^t \vec{v} \mathrm{d}t = \frac{15Pt}{14m} \vec{i} + \left( \frac{Pt}{m} - \frac{1}{2} \mu g t^2 \right) \vec{j}$$

$$x = \frac{15Pt}{14m}$$

$$y = \frac{Pt}{m} - \frac{1}{2} \mu g t^2$$

$$\Rightarrow y=\frac{14}{15}x-\frac{1}{2}\mu g(\frac{14m}{15P})^{2}x^{2}$$

(3) 两个阶段:滑动阶段和无滑动阶段

阶段I:滑动阶段

$$v_{1x} = v_{1} = \frac{15P}{14m}, v_{1y} = \frac{P}{m}, \omega_{1} = \frac{15P}{14mR}$$

$$\int \vec{f} = m \frac{\mathrm{d} \vec{v}}{\mathrm{d} t}$$

$t=0$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-10.png)

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{u}}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{v}}{\mathrm{d}t} + \frac{\mathrm{d}\vec{w}}{\mathrm{d}t} \times \vec{R} = \frac{1}{m}\vec{f} + \frac{1}{J}(\vec{R} \times \vec{f}) \times \vec{R} = \frac{1}{m}\vec{f} + \frac{R^2}{J}\vec{f} = -\frac{7}{2}\mu g\vec{e}_w$$

球面上与地面接触的点P的速度方向保持不变！ $\vec{e}_{u} = \vec{e}_{u_{1}}$ 为恒量！

$$\vec{u} \big|_{t = t_2} = \vec{u}_1 (1 - \frac{7}{2} \frac{\mu g t_2}{u_1}) = 0$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-11.png)

$$\vec{v}_{2}=\vec{v}_{1}-\frac{\mu g t_{2}}{u_{1}}\vec{u}_{1}=\vec{v}_{1}-\frac{2}{7}\vec{u}_{1}=\frac{15P}{14m}\vec{i}+\frac{5P}{7m}\vec{j}$$

$t=0$

$$x = x_{2} + v_{2x}t = \frac{15P^{2}}{49\mu m^{2}g} + \frac{15P}{14m}t$$

$$y = y_{2} + v_{2y}t = \frac{12P^{2}}{49\mu m^{2}g} + \frac{5P}{7m}t$$

$$\Rightarrow y = \frac{2}{3}x + \frac{2P^{2}}{49\mu m^{2}g}$$

综上:

$$\left[ \frac{14}{15}x - \frac{1}{2}\mu g(\frac{14m}{15P})^2 x^2, \quad (0 \leq x \leq \frac{15P^2}{49\mu m^2 g}) \right]$$

![](data/images/2023-v10-b334d806/2023-量子-暑假-第一套-v10-12.png)
